Learn how to use TVBO for defining, simulating, and analyzing brain network models.

```{=html}
<style>
.usage-filters {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.usage-filters button {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid #aaa;
  border-radius: 2rem;
  background: #f8f8f8;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.usage-filters button.active,
.usage-filters button:hover {
  background: #1a1a2e;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #1a1a2e;
}
.usage-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
}
.usage-card {
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.usage-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
.usage-card a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
.usage-card .card-visual {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.usage-card .card-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  background: #f0f0f0;
  display: block;
}
.usage-card .card-icon-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0.5rem;
  right: 0.5rem;
  width: 2.2rem;
  height: 2.2rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.usage-card .card-img-placeholder {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  color: #fff;
}
.usage-card .card-body {
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  flex: 1;
}
.usage-card .card-title {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}
.usage-card .card-desc {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.usage-card .card-cats {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}
.usage-card .cat-tag {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  background: #eef0f8;
  color: #444;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.usage-card.hidden { display: none; }
.section-header {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 2rem 0 0.8rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
}
</style>

<div class="usage-filters" id="usage-filters">
  <button class="active" data-cat="all">All</button>
</div>

<div id="usage-gallery"></div>

<script>
const PAGES = [
  // ── Fundamentals ──
  { title: "Defining Dynamical Systems",
    href: "DefineDynamicalSystem.html",
    desc: "Create neural mass models from YAML, Python, or the ontology.",
    cats: ["fundamentals","dynamics","YAML"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Defining Networks",
    href: "Network.html",
    desc: "Build brain networks from matrices, YAML, connectome databases, or BIDS.",
    cats: ["fundamentals","networks","connectome"],
    img: "thumbnails/DefineNetworks.png" },
  { title: "Simulation Experiments",
    href: "SimulationExperiments.html",
    desc: "Combine components, run on multiple backends, and inspect results.",
    cats: ["fundamentals","simulation","backends"],
    img: "" },

  // ── Code Generation ──
  { title: "Code Generation & Export",
    href: "CodeGeneration.html",
    desc: "Generate standalone simulation code in JAX, Python, Julia, CUDA, and export to YAML/BIDS/OpenMINDS.",
    cats: ["codegen","JAX","Julia","export"],
    img: "" },

  // ── Observation & Analysis ──
  { title: "Observation Models",
    href: "ObservationModels.html",
    desc: "BOLD, FC, PSD — define what to measure from simulations.",
    cats: ["analysis","observation","BOLD"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Parameter Exploration",
    href: "ParameterExploration.html",
    desc: "Systematic parameter sweeps and grid search across state spaces.",
    cats: ["analysis","optimization","sweeps"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Model Fitting",
    href: "ModelFitting.html",
    desc: "Loss functions and gradient-based optimization for empirical data.",
    cats: ["analysis","optimization","fitting"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Algorithms",
    href: "Algorithms.html",
    desc: "Built-in tuning algorithms (FIC, EIB) for balanced network states.",
    cats: ["analysis","algorithms","FIC"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Bifurcation Analysis",
    href: "BifurcationAnalysis.html",
    desc: "Stability analysis and bifurcation diagrams for dynamical systems.",
    cats: ["analysis","bifurcation","stability"],
    img: "thumbnails/BifurcationAnalysis.png" },

  // ── Simulation Features ──
  { title: "Events & Stimulation",
    href: "Events.html",
    desc: "External stimuli, per-region input, and time-varying parameters.",
    cats: ["simulation","stimulation","events"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Noise & Stochastic Integration",
    href: "Noise.html",
    desc: "Additive and multiplicative noise, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes.",
    cats: ["simulation","noise","stochastic"],
    img: "thumbnails/Noise.png" },

  // ── Advanced ──
  { title: "PDE Simulation",
    href: "PDESimulation.html",
    desc: "Surface-based PDE solving with finite elements (scikit-fem).",
    cats: ["advanced","PDE","surface"],
    img: "" },
  { title: "Heterogeneous Node Dynamics",
    href: "HeterogeneousNodes.html",
    desc: "Different dynamics at each network node for multi-population models.",
    cats: ["advanced","heterogeneous","networks"],
    img: "thumbnails/HeterogeneousNodes.png" },
  { title: "Heterogeneous Edge Dynamics",
    href: "HeterogeneousEdges.html",
    desc: "Synaptic plasticity and edge-level dynamics on network connections.",
    cats: ["advanced","heterogeneous","plasticity"],
    img: "thumbnails/HeterogeneousEdges.png" },
  { title: "Unit-Aware Computations",
    href: "UnitValidation.html",
    desc: "Physical units across simulation components for dimensionally consistent models.",
    cats: ["advanced","units","validation"],
    img: "" },
];

// Enrich PAGES with icon/gradient from shared registry
PAGES.forEach(p => {
  const slug = p.href.replace('.html', '');
  const info = TVBO_ICONS[slug] || {};
  p.icon = info.icon || "fa-solid fa-file";
  p.gradient = info.gradient || "linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)";
});

// ── build filter buttons ──
const allCats = [...new Set(PAGES.flatMap(p => p.cats))].sort();
const filterBar = document.getElementById('usage-filters');
allCats.forEach(cat => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.textContent = cat;
  btn.dataset.cat = cat;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => setFilter(cat));
  filterBar.appendChild(btn);
});

// ── build gallery sections ──
const sections = [
  { label: "Fundamentals",          cats: new Set(["fundamentals"]) },
  { label: "Code Generation",       cats: new Set(["codegen"]) },
  { label: "Observation & Analysis", cats: new Set(["analysis","observation","optimization","bifurcation","algorithms"]) },
  { label: "Simulation Features",   cats: new Set(["simulation","stimulation","noise","stochastic","events"]) },
  { label: "Advanced",              cats: new Set(["advanced"]) },
];

const gallery = document.getElementById('usage-gallery');

sections.forEach(sec => {
  const pages = PAGES.filter(p => p.cats.some(c => sec.cats.has(c)));
  if (!pages.length) return;

  const h = document.createElement('div');
  h.className = 'section-header';
  h.textContent = sec.label;
  h.dataset.section = sec.label;
  gallery.appendChild(h);

  const grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'usage-grid';
  grid.dataset.section = sec.label;
  gallery.appendChild(grid);

  pages.forEach(p => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'usage-card';
    card.dataset.cats = JSON.stringify(p.cats);

    // image or icon placeholder
    const imgWrap = document.createElement('a');
    imgWrap.href = p.href;

    const visual = document.createElement('div');
    visual.className = 'card-visual';

    if (p.img) {
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.className = 'card-img';
      img.loading = 'lazy';
      img.alt = p.title;
      img.src = p.img;
      img.onerror = function () {
        const ph = document.createElement('div');
        ph.className = 'card-img-placeholder';
        ph.style.background = p.gradient;
        ph.innerHTML = `<i class="${p.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
        this.replaceWith(ph);
      };
      visual.appendChild(img);
      // icon badge overlay on thumbnail
      const badge = document.createElement('div');
      badge.className = 'card-icon-badge';
      badge.style.background = p.gradient;
      badge.innerHTML = `<i class="${p.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
      visual.appendChild(badge);
    } else {
      const ph = document.createElement('div');
      ph.className = 'card-img-placeholder';
      ph.style.background = p.gradient;
      ph.innerHTML = `<i class="${p.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
      visual.appendChild(ph);
    }

    imgWrap.appendChild(visual);
    card.appendChild(imgWrap);

    // body
    const body = document.createElement('div');
    body.className = 'card-body';
    const title = document.createElement('a');
    title.href = p.href;
    title.innerHTML = `<div class="card-title">${p.title}</div>`;
    body.appendChild(title);
    const desc = document.createElement('div');
    desc.className = 'card-desc';
    desc.textContent = p.desc;
    body.appendChild(desc);
    const cats = document.createElement('div');
    cats.className = 'card-cats';
    p.cats.forEach(c => {
      const tag = document.createElement('span');
      tag.className = 'cat-tag';
      tag.textContent = c;
      tag.addEventListener('click', () => setFilter(c));
      cats.appendChild(tag);
    });
    body.appendChild(cats);
    card.appendChild(body);
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
});

// ── filter logic ──
let activeFilter = 'all';

function setFilter(cat) {
  activeFilter = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('.usage-filters button').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.cat === cat);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.usage-card').forEach(card => {
    const cardCats = JSON.parse(card.dataset.cats);
    card.classList.toggle('hidden', cat !== 'all' && !cardCats.includes(cat));
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.section-header').forEach(h => {
    const grid = h.nextElementSibling;
    const visible = [...grid.querySelectorAll('.usage-card')].some(c => !c.classList.contains('hidden'));
    h.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
    grid.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
</script>
```
